ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR26] Requires Estimated CuFt on moving into Solutioning, Negotiation or Booking Verification, for Project Services/Records Management deals. Simplified per IRM; now uses the live literal PPL values.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Project Services'), ISPICKVAL(Primary_Product_Line__c, 'Records Management') ),
OR( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ) ),
OR(ISBLANK(Expected_CuFt__c), Expected_CuFt__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Estimated CuFt is required. Please add estimated cuft.
